propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled once from structural signals only: reverts of STATUS/COMMITS events infer regression, plan-review BLOCKs infer plan_defect, gate_error_v1 events infer env_integration, and everything else infers undetermined.

Backfilled classifications are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson (NDJSON, one record per line) with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregating them from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill script must skip any bug already in the artifact file (by ticket_id) and any bug whose reduced state already contains close_class, ensuring idempotency.
REVERT signals must filter for target_event_type of STATUS or COMMITS (substantive reverts only); reverts of COMMENT or LINK alone must fall through to undetermined.

plan-review BLOCK signals are read via all_review_results (which accepts plan_review_result_v2 payloads); gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scanning of REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT JSON files.

Unit tests in tests/scripts/test_backfill_bug_class.py must verify each signal class (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, undetermined), non-overwriting of authoritative close_class, and substantive-revert filtering.
